name: automated-portfolio-management-platform
description: Nexus Solutions portfolio generation platform monorepo

scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:cv && npm run test:auth
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @nexus/shared run lint && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @nexus/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
